scope: Editorial interpretation of the three reviewed source stills; no automatic tracking or official event feed.

build.title: READ THE NEXT OPTION
build.subtitle: Spot the screen. Find the space.

steps.title: START WITH THE BALL
steps.text: City's carrier approaches halfway. A Newcastle player is positioned ahead of him.

steps.title: THE LINK IS SCREENED
steps.text: A Newcastle player stands in the passing lane to the teammate ahead. That direct link is covered, not open.

steps.title: SPACE TO CARRY
steps.text: Open grass lies ahead of the carrier, and the far-side teammate is unmarked. The gold arrow shows space, not a recorded run.

combine.title: FROM WIDE TO INSIDE
combine.subtitle: Read the carrier, the runner and the defenders.

steps.title: LOCATE THE CARRIER
steps.text: The ball has come infield. Compare the carrier with the supporting teammate behind the ball.

steps.title: LOOK INSIDE
steps.text: A City runner arrives centrally, level with the ball. The dashed arrow shows an inside option towards the arc.

steps.title: READ THE DEFENDERS
steps.text: Three Newcastle defenders are closer to goal than the ball. Check their positions before judging the inside option.

release.title: LOOK TO THE RIGHT
release.subtitle: Start in the centre. Then widen your view.

steps.title: START IN THE CENTRE
steps.text: A Newcastle player is close to the central carrier. The gold halo marks the area to inspect.

steps.title: FIND THE RIGHT-SIDE OPTION
steps.text: A City teammate is visible to the right near the box. The arrow highlights a possible outlet.

steps.title: CHECK THE NEARBY DEFENDERS
steps.text: The right-side teammate has defenders nearby. Compare their positions before following the next action.

geometry: Tactical layers use the measured ground plane in tactical-geometry.json. Each layer is checked against it before rendering.
